title: ACE: Quality of Life — Combat Automation Engine
description: Comprehensive D&D 5e combat automation. Attack resolution, damage separation by type, save automation, target state assessment, concentration tracking, and extended Active Effects — all in one module, everything ON by default.

recommends.reason: Powers ACE QOL's animation pipeline and the optional sound-effects layer.
